verdict.rationale: Daytona documents that each sandbox runs isolated with its own dedicated kernel, filesystem, network stack and allocated resources, so agent-run code does not share the host environment. A per-sandbox firewall restricts outbound destinations to prevent untrusted code from exfiltrating data. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that host secrets and credentials are unreachable (no secrets-management or credential-scoping docs), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the isolation boundary.
